core_obligations: Reduction: replace Z_i by its reduced closed subscheme; closed immersions are affine and closed, compositions affine, so Z_{i'} -> Z_i is affine by affine permanence.
Conclusion: each Z_i is quasi-compact; limit-nonempty gives a point of Z = lim Z_i; the canonical morphism Z -> S lands in every Z_i.
proof_roadmap: Reduced subscheme replacement; affineness of the transitions.
Quasi-compactness; limit-nonempty; canonical map to S.
